second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 11 + Average 4 + Difficulty 4 = 19), pdf 83; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-19 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-5, II 6-10, III 11-15, IV 16-18, q19 own header). Answer side keys 1-19 in order (pdf 123-124). BLUE PRINT 11/4/4 = 19 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 19.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 83 (heading, LO 10, BLUE PRINT, q1-5) 84 (q6-13) 85 (q14-19). A side 'Key answers :- 21 The game- Hide and seek' pdf 123 (keys 1-4) 124 (5-19). Folios = pdf page.
ANSWER SIDE (analysed first): keys 1-19 answer q1-q19 by printed number (aligned).

Sections: s1 I match q1-5 (numbered rows -> one-pair match); s2 II fill q6-10; s3 III mcq q11-15 (three options A-C -> 'source notation inconsistent'; keys print text only: q12 Chinni-Dandu A, q13 Lagori C, q14 A by pass 1; q11 'Chowkabara' and q15 'Lameness-striking.' match no option -> null + 'key text not among options' with suggested letter); s4 IV q16-18; s5 q19 (own header '1*4=4').
MARKS (R-E9, rev 3): s1-s3 1; s4 '3*2=6' -> 2; s5 '1*4=4' (N=1 = the one printed question) -> 4.

KEYS: match keys 1 'A game played using a board' and 4 'OutdoorGame' flagged against column B; q16 key printed over two lines ('… games, and' / 'We get it from newspapers.') joined; q19 key is a two-column table 'Indoor game | Outdoor game.' with six rows -> one step per row (the header row is not a step), cells joined with ' | '.
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 19 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 10, lo_source 'lesson_table'.
FIGURES: none on these pages. TOPIC evs-3-21-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
